name: AI Controls Matrix
description: Source-level record for CSA's AI Controls Matrix. The editions live in their version directories (0.0.2, 1.0.3, 1.1.0, 1.1.1). This record governs the CSA material kept at source level: the cross-release crosswalks in crosswalks/ (AICM 1.0.3 to 1.1.0, and AI-CAIQ 1.0.2 to 1.1.0, which carry control and question titles), VERSIONING.md and the README. The crosswalk and figure-check scripts are listed in the tier gate's TYPE_ROOT_INFRASTRUCTURE and pinned instead.

license.notes: CSA publications are typically released under CC BY-NC-SA 4.0. Copyright notice in the v1.1.1 workbook reads © Copyright 2026 Cloud Security Alliance.

desired_end_state.notes: Source-level record; the editions are the version directories.

notes: Added 2026-11-14 (dataset-public-laws-regulations-standards#154) so that the crosswalks and notes kept at source level have a governing record. CSA's own publication: the 4-tier hosting rule concerns third-party sources, so no access_tier is recorded.
